method: V0=60*40*30-54*34*27-4*A*6^2*30+4*A*3^2*27+L*A-2*pi*M, L=152+6*pi. The floor adds L*A-2*pi*M on the inward side of the already rounded cavity contour. A=1-pi/4 and M=5/6-pi/4 are the unit round section area and first moment. Outward parallel contours have Jacobian1+kappa*u and total turning2*pi. For the top inner chamfer, subtract L*d^2/2+pi*d^3/3 (triangle area d^2/2 and moment d^3/6), at size0.47.
